generationBrief.customPrompt: Find moments where the speaker directly addresses one of these viewer questions: 1) What microphone do you use for the voiceover? 2) How do you color grade your footage? 3) Could you cover this viewer request: "Please make a video on how you organize project files and folders"? Creator goal: Turn recurring viewer questions into Shorts. Choose self-contained segments where the answer or explanation is actually spoken or shown. Skip a question if the video never addresses it; do not force clips for it.
